records.text: An anonymous flight-tracking tipster reported that searches appeared to show Pam Bondi flew on C-37A tail 99-0404 about five months earlier from the Tampa area to Washington, D.C.
records.speaker: C-37A flight email tipster (identity unverified)

appearances.snippet: From other searches I've done, it appears that Pam Bondi flew on this plane approximately five months ago from Tampa area back to DC.

verification.notes: Verification attempted after reviewing the anonymous email in transcript context. AirNav's surviving record identifies tail 99-0404, Mode-S AE04F9, as SAM702 in southern Arizona on September 9, 2025, but no raw or archived ADS-B record located establishes a Tampa-area-to-Washington flight about five months earlier or Pam Bondi as a passenger. Under the historical-aircraft evidence rule, the claim remains unverifiable rather than false.

records.text: An anonymous flight-tracking tipster reported that C-37A tail 99-0404 flew from Colorado Springs to Tucson on September 8, its transponder then appeared to turn off, and it next appeared departing Fort Huachuca on September 9
records.speaker: C-37A flight email tipster (identity unverified)

appearances.snippet: On September 8th, it flew from Colorado Springs to Tucson. Then five hours later from Tucson, and then the transponder appears to be turned off. ... However, at 12 31 p.m. on September 9th, it flies from Fort Huachuca to El Paso and then El Paso back to Andrews Air Force Base.

verification.notes: AirNav Radar confirms that SAM702 on September 9, 2025 was a U.S. Air Force C-37A, registration 99-0404, tracked in southern Arizona. The surviving public record does not establish the complete Andrews–Colorado Springs–Tucson–Fort Huachuca–El Paso itinerary. The episode itself shows a Tucson transponder gap and then reports a Fort Huachuca departure, so a continuous Tucson-to-Fort-Huachuca flight was inferred rather than directly tracked. Aircraft identity is supported; the full routing claim is not.

sources.title: Flight SAM702 — United States Air Force — AirNav Radar
sources.relevance: Confirms SAM702 on September 9, 2025 was Air Force C-37A registration 99-0404 and was tracked in southern Arizona; the retained page does not establish the full claimed itinerary.
